title: SDF Text Rendering Shader
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js (via CDN) that implements a signed distance field (SDF) text rendering system with custom shaders on a full-screen quad. Requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Black background, orthographic camera viewing a full-screen quad.
- The quad uses a custom ShaderMaterial with vertex and fragment shaders.
- The fragment shader procedurally generates SDF representations of characters (implement at least digits 0-9 and letters A-F using SDF primitives: boxes, circles, line segments combined with union/subtraction/intersection).
- Render a default text string 'HELLO 3D' centered on screen.
- Each character glyph is built from SDF primitives (e.g., 'H' = two vertical bars + horizontal bar, 'E' = vertical bar + three horizontal bars, etc.).
- The SDF shader should support: adjustable edge softness (anti-aliasing width), glow effect, outline mode, and color theming.

## Shader Uniforms
- u_time: float, elapsed time for animations.
- u_resolution: vec2, viewport resolution.
- u_text: int array or encoded float representing which characters to display (up to 12 chars).
- u_charCount: int, number of active characters.
- u_fontSize: float, character scale factor (default 1.0, range 0.3 to 3.0).
- u_edgeSoftness: float, anti-aliasing width (default 0.01, range 0.001 to 0.1).
- u_glowIntensity: float, glow strength (default 0.0, range 0.0 to 2.0).
- u_outlineWidth: float, outline thickness (default 0.0, range 0.0 to 0.05).
- u_textColor: vec3, primary text color (default bright green 0.0, 1.0, 0.3).
- u_glowColor: vec3, glow color (default cyan 0.0, 0.8, 1.0).
- u_outlineColor: vec3, outline color (default white).
- u_animationMode: int, 0=none, 1=wave, 2=pulse, 3=typewriter.
- u_letterSpacing: float, spacing between characters (default 0.6, range 0.3 to 1.5).

## User Interactions
- A text input field (id='textInput') at the top of the screen where the user can type a new string (max 12 chars, auto-uppercased). Pressing Enter or clicking a 'Render' button (id='renderBtn') updates the displayed SDF text.
- A dropdown (id='animSelect') to choose animation mode: 'None', 'Wave', 'Pulse', 'Typewriter'.
- A slider (id='fontSizeSlider') to adjust font size from 0.3 to 3.0.
- A slider (id='softnessSlider') to adjust edge softness from 0.001 to 0.1.
- A slider (id='glowSlider') to adjust glow intensity from 0.0 to 2.0.
- A slider (id='outlineSlider') to adjust outline width from 0.0 to 0.05.
- A slider (id='spacingSlider') to adjust letter spacing from 0.3 to 1.5.
- A color picker (id='textColorPicker') for text color.
- A color picker (id='glowColorPicker') for glow color.
- Keyboard shortcut: pressing '1','2','3','4' keys sets animation mode to None/Wave/Pulse/Typewriter respectively.
- Keyboard shortcut: pressing '+' increases fontSize by 0.1, '-' decreases by 0.1 (clamped to range).

## HUD / UI Panel
- A semi-transparent dark panel (id='controlPanel') on the right side containing all controls.
- A toggle button (id='togglePanel') to show/hide the control panel.
- An FPS counter (id='fpsCounter') in the top-left corner.
- A status line (id='statusLine') below the FPS counter showing current text, char count, and animation mode name.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
  - currentText: string, the currently rendered text.
  - charCount: int, number of characters being rendered.
  - fontSize: float, current font size value.
  - edgeSoftness: float, current edge softness.
  - glowIntensity: float, current glow intensity.
  - outlineWidth: float, current outline width.
  - letterSpacing: float, current letter spacing.
  - textColor: {r, g, b} with values 0-1.
  - glowColor: {r, g, b} with values 0-1.
  - animationMode: int (0-3).
  - animationName: string ('None','Wave','Pulse','Typewriter').
  - panelVisible: boolean.
  - fps: number, current FPS.
  - elapsedTime: float, total elapsed time in seconds.
  - frameCount: int, total frames rendered.
  - uniformsValid: boolean, true if all shader uniforms are finite and within expected ranges.
  - shaderCompiled: boolean, true if shader compiled without errors.
physics_constraints: All uniform values must remain within their defined ranges at all times. Font size clamped [0.3, 3.0]. Edge softness clamped [0.001, 0.1]. Glow intensity clamped [0.0, 2.0]. Outline width clamped [0.0, 0.05]. Letter spacing clamped [0.3, 1.5]. Color components clamped [0.0, 1.0]. No NaN or Infinity in any uniform. Character count must match the length of the current text string. Animation mode must be an integer in [0, 3].
